stem:
Carts of different masses are pulled along a flat surface. The table shows some variables for each cart.

Acceleration Variables

| Cart | Applied Force (N) | Frictional Force (N) | Mass (kg) |
|------|-------------------|----------------------|-----------|
| 1    | 22                | 18                   | 4.0       |
| 2    | 32                | 27                   | 5.0       |
| 3    | 19                | 14                   | 2.0       |
| 4    | 38                | 30                   | 16        |

Which two carts experience the same net force?
visual_elements: table with columns: Cart, Applied Force (N), Frictional Force (N), Mass (kg) and rows with values: (1, 22, 18, 4.0), (2, 32, 27, 5.0), (3, 19, 14, 2.0), (4, 38, 30, 16)
